description_for_human: Weather, place search, geocoding and route planning in China from Amap (Gaode Maps) Web Service API.
description_for_model: Weather, place search, geocoding and route planning in China from Amap (Gaode Maps) Web Service API.

functions.name: geocodeAddress
functions.description: Converts a structured address or well-known place name in China to longitude,latitude coordinates and administrative codes. Use it before route planning when the user gives place names instead of coordinates.

functions.name: getDrivingRoute
functions.description: Plans a driving route between two coordinates. Returns distance, duration, tolls, traffic lights, taxi cost estimate and turn-by-turn steps.

functions.name: getTransitRoute
functions.description: Plans public transport routes (subway, bus, walking) between two coordinates. Requires the citycode (e.g. 010 Beijing, 021 Shanghai, 0571 Hangzhou) of the origin and destination cities, which geocodeAddress returns.

functions.name: getWalkingRoute
functions.description: Plans a walking route between two coordinates (best for under about 5 km). Returns distance in meters, duration in seconds and turn-by-turn steps.

functions.name: getWeather
functions.description: Returns live weather (extensions=base) or a 4-day forecast (extensions=all) for a city or district in China.

functions.name: reverseGeocode
functions.description: Returns the address, district and nearby business areas for a longitude,latitude coordinate in China.

functions.name: searchNearby
functions.description: Searches points of interest within a radius around a longitude,latitude coordinate, sorted by distance. Get the coordinate with geocodeAddress first if the user gives a place name.

functions.name: searchPlaces
functions.description: Searches points of interest (restaurants, cafes, hotels, attractions, shops, stations...) by keyword within a city. Returns name, address, coordinates, rating, average cost, opening hours, phone and photos.
